build_SO2_Convolution: build an SO(2) convolution module for all spherical harmonic orders with optional radial gating
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO(2) linear layer for all spherical harmonic orders with optional radial function
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build an SO(2) convolution block using block-diagonal GEMM for faster tensor core utilization
refactor_SO2_Convolution_to_block: refactor an SO2_Convolution to use SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock or SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock for performance
review_SO2_m_Conv: review the SO2_m_Conv class that performs SO(2) convolution on features for a single m order
